author: Inside Edition
description: Lindsay Clancy is on trial in Massachusetts, accused of killing her three children in 2023. The former nurse says she is not guilty because the killings happened during a moment of postpartum psychosis. Today we heard her voice, as the judge asked her questions in court. This sixth day of her trial also focused on prescription medications found at her house. If she is convicted, Clancy faces life in prison without a chance of parole. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano has the details.
title: Lindsay Clancy Speaks In Court

author: Inside Edition
description: There were scary moments as a plane made an emergency landing on a Florida interstate. It was half an hour into a training flight when fumes reportedly started filling the cockpit. The pilot knew she had to land, even though there was no airport in sight. The single engine plane narrowly missed road signs and vehicles before touching down safely. Now, the FAA is investigating the incident, as Inside Edition's Justin Finch tells us what happened.
title: Plane 'Threads The Needle' To Land On Florida Interstate

author: Inside Edition
description: Being a new mom is exhausting. One busy news anchor recently proved that point when she was caught napping right in the middle of a live broadcast. Dominique Dillon anchors broadcasts for a station in Memphis, Tennessee. Viewers caught her closing her eyes during a live segment, and the moment went viral. But many are jumping to her defense, and Dillon herself is laughing at the candid caught-on-camera moment. Inside Edition's Andrea Grymes has the details.
title: TV Anchor Nods Off During Live Broadcast

author: Inside Edition
description: A new three-part documentary series about the quadruple University of Idaho murders is the No. 1 show on Netflix. In the wake of the success of "The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare," the family of one  victim is speaking with Inside Edition. Relatives told Alison Hall they want Bryan Kohberger to be sentenced to death by firing squad. Kohberger is seeking to abandon his guilty plea in the case and go to trial, claiming he is innocent of the killings.
title: Idaho Murder Victim's Family Wants Bryan Kohberger To Face Firing Squad

author: Inside Edition
description: A frantic call from a mother had Atlanta Police out in full force. The woman said she left her 2-year-old child in the car while she made a delivery, but it was enough time for someone to jump in the driver's seat and take off. Plate readers from around the city were used and police say after 15 minutes, they located the car. The suspect was arrested and the child was unharmed. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Suspect Drives Away In Car With 2-Year-Old Girl In The Backseat

author: Inside Edition
description: A lesson in money matters took a scary turn. Hunter, 9, says he had some money from chores and birthday gifts  burning a hole in his pocket. He wanted to put it somewhere safe, so his grandmother took him to open a bank account. While they were waiting, Hunter says he saw someone in a black ski mask jump behind the counter and draw a gun. He told his grandmother the bank was being robbed. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 9-Year-Old Opening Savings Account Witnesses Bank Robbery

author: Inside Edition
description: In March, Amy McGorry asked the public to help her find a living donor who would be willing to give her a piece of their liver. Just three months later, she got the news that someone stepped up to help save her life.
title: Woman Surprised To Learn Liver Transplant Donor Is Longtime Friend #shorts
